SOCIAL STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Language groups in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Language groups in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   B. Explain Language groups in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Language groups in Eastern Africa.
   D. Say Language groups in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.

2. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Ignore prices in shops

3. Which statement about Climatic regions in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   C. Mombasa
   D. Kisumu

6. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Measure rainfall only

   A. Skip evidence when discussing School and Community.

   C. Treat School and Community as rumours only.
   D. Explain School and Community with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Which statement about Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   A. Say Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa.
   C. Explain Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa as rumours only.

14. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Littering in markets

----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Main physical features in Eastern Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
